📖 How to use

      
  1. Set the amplitude, number of waves, height and color.
  2. Preview the wave divider live.
  3. Flip it vertically if you need a top-edge wave.
  4. Click "Copy SVG" and paste it into your HTML.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Are the waves sharp on all screens?
The SVG is generated from a smooth sine path, so it stays crisp at any screen size or resolution.
Is the wave responsive?
The SVG uses width:100% and preserveAspectRatio="none", so it stretches to fit any container width.
Can I layer two waves?
Yes — copy the flipped SVG again with a different color, or stack two with negative margin, for layered wave sections.
